mappings.basis: Agere operational decomposition for review, informed by USPSTF and CDC STEADI. Components are review responsibilities, not a complete clinical protocol, confirmed indication or established buyer capability.

components.label: Assessed falls-prevention exercise delivery
checks: Verify actual intervention, suitable staff and supervision, delivery format and clinical assessment.
Confirm patient agreement, practical participation and exact benefit requirements.

components.label: Participation and safety follow-up
checks: Specify who reviews participation, problems and relevant outcomes.
A packet, schedule or attendance report does not establish clinical benefit.

components.label: Qualified falls-risk assessment
checks: Verify assessment responsibility, current clinical information and necessary examination arrangements.
A received interview or service tag does not establish a completed clinical assessment.

components.label: Assessment-directed intervention coordination
checks: Identify only the components supported by an actual assessment; do not require every possible intervention for every patient.
Confirm accountable delivery teams, handoffs, patient agreement and benefit conditions for each selected component.
